hotels.title: Stylish Albury Escape at Mercure in the Heart of Town
hotels.description: In the heart of Albury, this polished retreat places you moments from Dean Street’s acclaimed dining scene, including modern Australian plates at Canvas Eatery and house-roasted coffee at local favourite Mr Benedict. Contemporary rooms are paired with an outdoor pool, sauna and a sleek onsite restaurant and bar. Step outside to explore the Murray Art Museum Albury, celebrated for its striking architecture and thought-provoking exhibitions, or wander the Botanic Gardens’ heritage pathways and manicured lawns. The Murray River precinct and Noreuil Park are also within easy reach for riverside walks and paddle-steamer views
